commands: ALB_URL=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name MoodleCdkStack --region "$REGION" --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='MoodleUrl'].OutputValue" --output text 2>/dev/null || true)

if [ -z "$ALB_URL" ] || [ "$ALB_URL" = "None" ]; then DNS=$(aws elbv2 describe-load-balancers --region "$REGION" --query "LoadBalancers[?starts_with(LoadBalancerName, 'Moodle')].DNSName" --output text 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); if [ -n "$DNS" ]; then ALB_URL="http://$DNS"; fi; fi
